log_streams.description: List of log stream configurations for cronolog to handle (e.g., access, error, custom logs). Each item defines a log stream and its rotation parameters.

log_streams[].delay.description: Delay (e.g., '5m') before rotation occurs within the period. Cannot exceed the period.

log_streams[].hardlink.description: Path for a hard link to the current log file (via `--hardlink`).

log_streams[].name.description: Optional human-readable name for the log stream (used only in comments).

log_streams[].once_only.description: If true, create a single non-rotating log file (via `--once-only`).

log_streams[].period.description: Explicit rotation period (e.g., '1h', '30m', '1d', '1w', '1mo') using cronolog's period format. Must be a factor of the next larger unit.

log_streams[].prev_symlink.description: Path for a symbolic link to the previous log file (via `--prev-symlink`). Requires `symlink` to be set.

log_streams[].symlink.description: Path for a symbolic link to the current log file (via `--symlink`).

log_streams[].template.description: Path template for log file naming using strftime-like specifiers (e.g., %Y, %m, %d). Required.
